name: Chigimi-chan
source:
It's spring. The soft bed-time sheets feel good...
Next to me the person I love seems to be happily sleeping.
So happy... Ah, He woke up?
Good Morning.
Hey, What should we do today Gokaku-san?
translation:
春天到了。柔软的被单让人感觉真好……
我爱的那个人似乎正在身边幸福地熟睡。
好开心……啊，她醒了？
早上好。
喂，今天我们要做什么，五觉小姐？
